note: Summarised from each module's own handoff report (files in this folder and ml_water/, ml_electricity/). Gates were declared before training; held-out data was scored once by a locked script, or not at all.

sectors.label: Approved: advisory anomaly detection
sectors.model: Model C: predictive residual, HistGradientBoostingRegressor, trained on normal data only
sectors.held_out: 4/4 documented attacks detected, precision 0.953, recall 0.679, PR-AUC 0.868, 1.37 false alarms per 7 days (evaluated once)
sectors.allowed_wording: Historical replay of a benchmark simulation; advisory evidence, never marks a device compromised or a service lost.

sectors.label: Approved: advisory attack screening (low coverage)
sectors.dataset: MSU-ORNL Power System Attack Dataset, three-class release (benchmark samples, no timestamps)
sectors.model: Random Forest, 100 trees, 89 load-invariant features, attack threshold 0.655
sectors.held_out: attack precision 0.946, attack recall 0.396, natural disturbance called attack 7.2%, normal called attack 0% (data13-15, evaluated once)
sectors.allowed_wording: Sample explorer of benchmark data. A flag means investigate; no flag never means safe (about 40% of attacks flagged).

sectors.label: Demonstration benchmark only (protocol gates unmet)
sectors.dataset: TON_IoT telemetry (3 device files) and CICIoT2023 (curated Parquet derivative)
sectors.model: HistGradientBoosting on 29 features (capture artefact and window aggregates excluded)
sectors.held_out: Protocol test impossible (no session fields). Demonstration on the provided random split, run once: attack recall 0.889 at 4.0% benign false positives; on test rows never seen in training, recall 0.786. Floods ~100%, Recon 54%, Web 47%.
sectors.allowed_wording: Random-split, in-distribution benchmark demonstration on a curated CICIoT2023 derivative; not an independent evaluation. The IoT protocol gates remain unmet.

sectors.label: NO-GO at the held-out test
sectors.model: Random Forest data-alteration advisory detector (frozen before the test)
sectors.held_out: found all 7 data-alteration bursts (recall 100%), but normal false-positive rate 7.07% against a 1% gate and precision 46.4% against an 80% gate
sectors.allowed_wording: The man-in-the-middle delay signature is real but could not be separated from normal latency episodes at a usable false-alarm rate on this recording.

sectors.label: NO-GO at validation (held-out never scored)
sectors.dataset: UNSW-NB15 research benchmark (synthetic lab traffic, not operator or 5G telemetry)
sectors.held_out: not run. Best validation (HGB): recall 0.882 against a 0.90 gate, unique-vector recall 0.745 against 0.85, Fuzzers recall 0.36 against 0.50
sectors.allowed_wording: Flow classifiers evaluated on the UNSW-NB15 research benchmark did not meet pre-declared detection criteria once testbed artefacts and duplicate records were controlled for.

sectors.label: NO-GO at validation (held-out never scored)
sectors.dataset: Synthetic traffic-control security simulator (v2, passed its own integrity audit)
sectors.held_out: not run. Best (HGB): ROC-AUC 0.745, harmful-event coverage 0.70 against a 0.80 gate; false alarms during natural detector faults above 5%
sectors.allowed_wording: A synthetic traffic-control security testbed was built; detectors evaluated on it did not meet operational false-alarm and coverage criteria.
